scope: One false-positive class in core AQA school-mock flashcard marking: pasting the full flashcard question into its answer box could score full marks. Fix is an exact full-question repeat guard, not a broad substring ban.
method: Inspect actual v388 production evaluator before fix with input = original front on each active mock card, then verify v389 marks exact echoes wrong. If question text is literally a listed correct answer, retain correct status. Full stored model answers must remain correct and 'I don't know' and 'not [model answer]' must never earn full credit.
limitations: This narrow guard cannot detect a rephrased echo or every free-text wrong answer.
Does not establish mastery, proof marking, diagram marking or complete AQA syllabus coverage.
Does not modify original deck, XP, progress, cloud sync, card IDs or mock scope.
